newsitem.title: KENYA: More than 10,000 Ugandans return from former Zaire.
newsitem.headline: More than 10,000 Ugandans return from former Zaire.

text.p: More than 10,000 Ugandans have returned in the last few days to Uganda from the northeast of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, formerly Zaire, a U.N. official said on Tuesday.
"In the last few days 12,000 to 13,000 Ugandans in the Beni area have returned to Bundibugyo in western Uganda," U.N. World Food Programme spokeswoman Brenda Barton said in Nairobi.

"That means there are about 15,000 Ugandans left in the Beni area where they arrived a month ago," she said. "The return of the 12,000 makes the total number of displaced in the Bundibugyo area 72,000."
The Ugandans fled fighting around Bundibugyo, a remote town at the foot of the Ruwenzori Mountains, between Uganda's government army and Moslem-based rebels of the Allied Democratic Forces.
